label: Access this window
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the faith conversion window itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The name appears on other window types too, so this is read from the name only.

label: Piety cost
summary: The amount of piety the conversion shown in the window costs, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as "Conversion cost" and as the total cost in the conversion window texts.

label: Piety missing
summary: The amount of piety the player still lacks to pay for the conversion, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as "Missing" in a text, and the window shows that part only when the number is greater than 0.

label: Can convert
summary: Whether the conversion shown in the window can be done now (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to switch the convert button on or off.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the faith conversion window.
details: Vanilla runs it when the close button is clicked.

label: Convert
summary: Carries out the conversion the window shows.
details: Vanilla runs it when the convert button is clicked. The name says it covers both the faith and the rite (a faith's ritual practice).

label: Conversion blockers
summary: A text listing what keeps the conversion from being done.
details: Vanilla puts it in the tooltips of the convert buttons for a faith and for a rite.

label: Faith to convert to
summary: The faith the conversion window is about.
details: Vanilla compares it with the player's own faith to tell a faith conversion from a rite conversion, and reads its name from it.

label: Hostility level
summary: A whole number for how hostile the old faith is towards the player after converting.
details: Vanilla passes it to a helper that turns it into a name, in the sentence "Your old Faith will consider you ...".

label: Piety cost explanation
summary: A text explaining how the piety cost of the conversion comes about.
details: Vanilla puts it under the "Conversion cost" line in the cost tooltip.

label: Rite to convert to
summary: The rite (a faith's ritual practice) the conversion window is about.
details: Vanilla reads the rite's name from it for the window title and description, and uses it as the data for a part of the window.

label: Vassal conversion part
summary: Going by its name, the part of the conversion window that deals with the player's vassals converting.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a sub-part of the conversion window. What that part shows is not stated in the input, so this is read from the name.

label: This window
summary: Going by its name, the faith conversion window itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name appears on many other types, so this is read from the name only.

label: Access this icon
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the faith icon itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The name appears on other types too, so this is read from the name only.

label: Icon name
summary: The name of a faith icon, as text.
details: Vanilla passes it to the rite creation window when an icon is clicked, to select that icon.

label: Icon image
summary: The picture of a faith icon.
details: Vanilla uses it as the image of an icon shown in the rite creation window.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether this faith icon is the one currently chosen (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it in the rite creation window to show a part (likely a selection mark) only for the chosen icon.

label: This icon
summary: Going by its name, the faith icon itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name appears on many other types, so this is read from the name only.

label: Access this item
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the faith list item itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The name appears on other types too, so this is read from the name only.

label: Faith of the item
summary: The faith that a list entry stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of the faith window and reads its name in the ledger.

label: Rites of the item
summary: The list of rites (ritual practices) of the faith the entry stands for.
details: Vanilla counts it for the "number of rites" text and uses it as the list shown in the faith window.

label: This item
summary: Going by its name, the faith list item itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name appears on many other types, so this is read from the name only.

label: Access this faith type
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the faith type itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The name appears on other types too, so this is read from the name only.

label: Index
summary: Going by its name, the position number of the faith type in the game's list of them.
details: The game documents nothing more, and no line uses it for this type. The name is also used on other types, which is only a hint.

label: Key
summary: Going by its name, the key (the internal name used in script) of the faith type, as text.
details: The game documents nothing more, and no line uses it for this type. The name is also used on other types, which is only a hint.

label: Log name
summary: Going by its name, a name of the faith type meant for log output, as text.
details: The game documents nothing more, and no line in the game uses the name at all.

label: Is valid
summary: Going by its name, whether the faith type exists and can be used (yes or no).
details: The game documents nothing more, and no line uses it for this type. The name is also used on other types, which is only a hint.

label: Localized text
summary: Going by its name, the display text of the faith type in the player's language, as text.
details: It takes one argument. The game documents nothing more, and no line uses it for this type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, it is what is to be translated.

label: This faith type
summary: Going by its name, the faith type itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name appears on many other types, so this is read from the name only.

label: Access this window
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the faith window itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The name appears on other window types too, so this is read from the name only.

label: Can create rite
summary: Whether a new rite (a ritual practice of the faith) can be created from the faith window (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to decide whether a part of the faith window is shown, together with checks of the tutorial's "puppet" settings.

label: Can edit rite
summary: Whether a rite can be edited from the faith window (yes or no).
details: Vanilla uses it to show or hide a part of the faith window.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the faith window.
details: Vanilla runs it when the close button is clicked.

label: Convert button shown
summary: Whether the convert button belongs in the faith window right now (yes or no).
details: Vanilla combines it with checks on the rite (visible in the interface, not only historical) to show the convert button.

label: Challengers part
summary: Going by its name, the part of the faith window that deals with challengers.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a sub-part of the faith window. What exactly it shows is not stated in the input, so this is read from the name.

label: Core tenets
summary: The list of the faith's core tenets (its main beliefs) shown in the faith window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list that the window draws entries from.

label: Divergence breakdown
summary: Going by its name, a breakdown of how much a rite differs from the faith, for the rite given.
details: Vanilla passes it the selected rite or a holy order's rite and uses the result as the data of a part of the faith window. The exact content is not stated in the input, so this is read from the name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a rite, as vanilla passes the selected rite or a holy order's rite

label: Doctrine categories
summary: The list of doctrine categories of the faith shown in the faith window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list that the window draws entries from.

label: Shown faith
summary: The faith the faith window is showing.
details: Vanilla reads its adjective and other texts from it, for example in the header of the saints list.

label: Faith as scope
summary: Going by its name, the shown faith as a scope (the kind of thing script can run on).
details: The game's documentation says it returns a top-level scope. No line uses it on this type; the rite creation window has a function of the same name that is used.

label: Holy orders
summary: The list of holy orders of the shown faith.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list the window draws entries from, and checks whether it is empty to show or hide a part of the window.

label: Other faiths' holy sites
summary: Going by its name, the list of holy sites that belong to other faiths, shown in the faith window.
details: Vanilla uses it as a list for the window and shows the part only when the list is not empty. That these are other faiths' sites is read from the name.
